task: binary direction prediction for same-receptor, same-assay, same-WT-background single amino-acid peptide mutations

affinity_target.gain_rule: ratio <= 0.5 and the 95% uncertainty interval is wholly below 1
affinity_target.loss_rule: ratio >= 2 and the 95% uncertainty interval is wholly above 1
affinity_target.otherwise: ambiguous or near-neutral; retain in audit, not the binary denominator
affinity_target.censored_no_binding: count as loss only when a documented assay limit proves at least a 2-fold loss; never impute a point Kd
affinity_target.error_requirement: identify SD/SEM/fit error, n, and replicate structure; otherwise HOLD

historical_development_controls.status: MDM2-PMI/p53 is DEVELOPMENT / STRESS TEST, never the independent family holdout
historical_development_controls.frozen_results: retain existing GraphPep/FoldX results and the strict feedback-control outcome; do not re-run P27A or tune new rules against these examples

primary_metric: within-system balanced direction accuracy = (gain recall + loss recall)/2; report each WT background and macro-average backgrounds with equal weight; do not pool across receptors or assays
secondary_metrics: report coverage and all failures; optional within-system Spearman/log10(Kd) must include n and never replace the primary direction metric

candidate_scorers_equal_status.selection_policy: Freeze all candidate methods and score directions before any new score is inspected; no method is designated primary in advance

FoldX_AnalyseComplex_InteractionEnergy.direction: lower energy is predicted stronger binding

GraphPep.delta: score_WT - score_variant; positive is surrogate improvement, not Kd or ΔG improvement

ESM2_sequence_log_likelihood.mode: single-sequence masked pseudo-log-likelihood: sum over each residue of log probability of the original residue when that position is masked
ESM2_sequence_log_likelihood.delta: PLL_variant - PLL_WT; positive predicts gain; zero is tie
ESM2_sequence_log_likelihood.input_policy: score peptide sequence alone; no receptor concatenation or label-dependent setting

interface_heavy_atom_contact_pair_count.delta: contacts_variant - contacts_WT; positive predicts gain; zero is tie
interface_heavy_atom_contact_pair_count.definition: distinct cross-chain heavy-atom pairs within 6.0 Å, to be frozen in code before scoring

score_configuration_gate.FoldX: freeze licensed binary/version, RepairPDB and AnalyseComplex commands, chain assignment, pH/ionic-strength options, and matched WT/variant structure policy
score_configuration_gate.GraphPep: freeze installed code, checkpoint/feature hashes, exact inference command, score field and aggregation; no reinstall or model download
score_configuration_gate.ESM2: verify existing checkpoint path and SHA-256 before scoring; if unavailable, record scorer unavailable rather than download another model
score_configuration_gate.AFM: freeze installed ColabFold version, model 1, 3 recycles, no templates, same receptor MSA, paired peptide input, and two fixed random seeds
score_configuration_gate.contact_baseline: freeze atom selection, chain mapping, distance cutoff and pair counting rule

prediction_rule.FoldX_and_GraphPep: delta > tie band predicts gain; delta < negative tie band predicts loss; otherwise tie
prediction_rule.ESM_and_contacts: positive delta predicts gain, negative predicts loss, exact zero is tie
prediction_rule.ties: count incorrect in primary denominator and report separately
prediction_rule.no_contact_or_unscorable_structure: method failure; incorrect for that eligible label, retained in denominator
prediction_rule.low_confidence_or_clash: retain and report; never filter away from primary denominator
prediction_rule.seed_flip: count as unstable; stable correctness requires both seeds to predict the true direction

pilot.entry_requirement: at least one confidently labeled gain and one confidently labeled loss from the same WT background, plus resolved input chemistry and constructs
pilot.design: one WT + one source-verified gain + one source-verified loss, each in two AFM seeds; maximum 6 complexes
pilot.purpose: engineering feasibility and cross-seed stability only; not method selection, direction efficacy, or biological replication

full_panel_signal_gate.gain_and_loss_counts: at least 4 confidently labeled pairs in each class
full_panel_signal_gate.backgrounds: at least two WT peptide backgrounds, with both classes not contributed by only one background
full_panel_signal_gate.interpretation: limited method-selection signal for that single receptor-assay system only; needs confirmation in a separately selected system before any independent-validation claim

source_qualification.construct_assay: same receptor construct and assay within every paired comparison; distinguish Kd from Ki/IC50
source_qualification.peptide: standard amino acids, one substitution, same parent background; exact termini and noncanonical modifications must be resolved
source_qualification.development_exposure: record paper-level use, project-level method selection, and model-training overlap separately; disclose DEVELOPMENT whenever exposed
source_qualification.GraphPep_overlap: exact-ID search with no hit is not proof of no model pretraining exposure; current WSL training-list audit remains unresolved

resource_budget.full_single_system_max: 20 single mutants plus corresponding WT backgrounds; 48 total AFM complexes including pilot

current_decision: HOLD_NO_PILOT; no audited source currently meets bidirectional labels, uncertainty semantics, terminal chemistry, structure match, and development-independence requirements together
